name: 37865 · Seymour, TN
findings: ZIP 37865 (Seymour) has 45 nonprofit organizations. 14 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (50% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37865 (Seymour) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 37865 (Seymour) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 37% of the typical level).
